openings.claim: Unequal topic familiarity, beyond proficiency mismatch alone, may hinder pair starts; preserve the valued structure while testing shared entry.
openings.discriminator: Fresh self-contained equivalent prompts plus mutual introduction predict earlier reciprocal speech and greater usefulness, especially with unequal familiarity.
openings.probe: Randomize consenting pairs within-session to usual versus fresh equivalent prompts with one-minute introduction; privately record familiarity without proficiency labels; anonymously observe reciprocal-start time and individual speaking minutes; collect usefulness reports and preparation time.
openings.uncertainty: Equivalent prompts must fit coordination limits; private familiarity reporting is assumed. Proficiency and prompt differences remain rivals.

openings.claim: Current/earlier task confusion may cause preparation errors; test paper handoff before attributing them to attendance or motivation.
openings.discriminator: Dated paper naming next session and one task predicts fewer earlier-task answers than existing presentation.
openings.probe: Consenting attendees receive identical tasks in existing or reusable dated-card format; privately identify task/session; count earlier answers and blanks separately; correct every misunderstanding and give everyone dated information; log printing, explanation and messaging time.
openings.uncertainty: Immediate identification may not predict later recall. Account-free cards and unconditional participation are required.

openings.claim: Speculative self-calibrating conversation could continuously adjust individual support/challenge around one fresh prompt without proficiency disclosure or attendance dependence.
openings.discriminator: If entry difficulty or turn allocation lowers usefulness, supported rounds predict greater useful minutes for both partners and smaller speaking gaps; balanced speech without improved usefulness weakens this explanation.
openings.probe: Reuse sheets with optional starters/extensions; alternate speaker roles for two six-minute turns, then jointly choose support changes. Counterbalance usual/supported-round order with comparable fresh prompts; anonymously observe individual speech; collect round usefulness/entry-difficulty slips; log preparation in weekly totals.
openings.uncertainty: Full capability needs accessible entry, independent scaffolds, turn allocation and reliable useful-challenge signals. Adaptation within existing volunteer time and private support selection are assumed; balance need not imply usefulness.

openings.claim: Speculative attendance-independent packets could restore preparation continuity through calendar dates without learner tracking.
openings.discriminator: If stale information causes errors, dated packets predict fewer earlier-task answers; persistent blanks suggest another barrier.
openings.probe: Use six dated detachable cards from existing topics with session spares. Counterbalance current-sheet/packet identification order; distinguish earlier errors from blanks; track identification over six sessions; include creation, printing and replacements within 90 weekly coordination minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Requires stable six-session topics, self-contained tasks, unambiguous dates and paper distribution; retention/replacement is assumed. Preparation and previous attendance cannot become entry requirements.

lineage.reason: Speculative capability, partial test and defeat condition retained.
Continuity mechanism and longitudinal test retained.

decision: Retain four tests; declared preserves fits remain conditional on stated feasibility assumptions. Historical synthetic fixture establishes no replicated effects; speaking was untimed and slips unlinked. Participation stays free, including missed sessions and refusal of public proficiency labels. Every probe fits one Wednesday room/75 minutes, no paid facilitation, account/smartphone-free preparation and conversational practice; examination or unrelated-assignment substitution is forbidden. Unknown feasibility cannot relax constraints. Six-session targets: 80% report at least ten useful speaking minutes, 85% identify next preparation, coordination below 90 minutes/week. Useful-practice definitions, pair speech distribution, attendance reasons and coordination-task costs remain unmeasured.
